# `grow-jaeger` (`grow_jaeger`) — agent quickstart (Python)

Ships inside the wheel (`python -c "import grow_jaeger, pathlib; print(pathlib.Path(grow_jaeger.__file__).with_name('AGENTS.md').read_text())"`).
Docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/jaeger/ · Service: Jaeger · Categories: tracing.

```sh
pip install grow-jaeger
# PyPI may not carry it yet: pip install "grow-jaeger @ git+https://github.com/grow-codes-packages/jaeger@python-vX.Y.Z#subdirectory=python"
```

## Client

```python
from grow_jaeger import JaegerClient

# GROW_JAEGER_* > vendor env > defaults (AsyncJaegerClient has the same API)
client = JaegerClient.from_env()
client.close()
```

Errors: `JaegerError` subclasses (`ConfigError`, `AuthenticationError`, `NotFoundError`, …) with `code`,
`retryable`, `http_status`. Credentials are `Secret`; never log `reveal()` results.

## Tracing

The tracing entry point (`initTracing` / `InitTracing` / `init_tracing`) and its options are documented in the
package README and https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/jaeger/tracing/ (span helpers `withSpan`, `traced`,
`currentTraceId`, HTTP middleware).
